item.title: Show HN: Manhwa AI – Create webtoons with consistent AI characters
item.summary: Hi HN, I built Manhwa AI because creating a webtoon with consistent characters still requires a lot of manual work. The product lets users define their characters, generate a storyboard, create individual panels, add dialogue, and export the finished comic. The main challenge has been maintaining the same face, clothing, and visual style across multiple scenes. It is currently an early version, and I am especially interested in feedback on: 1. Character consistency 2. The storyboard-to-panel workflow 3. Whether the editor provides enough control I built most of the product myself and would be happy to answer technical or product questions.
